title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
summary: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.
llm_summary: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft upgrades the first‑gen model with a slimmer, lighter body and an edge‑to‑edge, color‑enhanced e‑ink display, positioning it as a premium e‑reader. While the design and screen improvements look impressive, the core reading experience is largely unchanged, so existing Colorsoft owners have little incentive to upgrade despite the higher price tag.
